# CloudFinOps
> AI-powered FinOps platform that detects idle cloud resources, reduces waste by up to 30%, and automates governance across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

## About
CloudFinOps is a SaaS platform for cloud cost optimization. It provides read-only, agentless scanning of AWS, Azure, and GCP accounts to identify idle resources, rightsizing opportunities, and governance violations. Setup takes under 5 minutes.

## Key Capabilities
- Multi-cloud waste detection (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- AI-powered idle resource identification
- Rightsizing recommendations with cost impact
- Commitment optimization (Reserved Instances, Savings Plans)
- Governance automation and compliance reporting
- Real-time anomaly detection with Holt-Winters forecasting
- Read-only scanning — no write access required

## Compliance
- SOC 2 Type II controls
- ISO 27001 aligned
- GDPR compliant
- HIPAA capable
- TLS 1.3, AES-256-GCM encryption
